subject: general
question: The average weight of 54 members of a club is 67.5 kg. If 6 members of average weight 72.5 kg leave and 2 new members of average weight 62.5 kg join the club, then the average weight (in kg) of the present members of the club is:
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Net weight change of leavers = 6 × (72.5 − 67.5) = +30 kg (loss)

Net weight change of joiners = 2 × (62.5 − 67.5) = −10 kg (loss)

Total net weight change = −30 − 10 = −40 kg

Current total members = 54 − 6 + 2 = 50 members

Average weight change = −40 ÷ 50 = −0.8 kg

New average = 67.5 − 0.8 = 66.7 kg

**∴ The correct option is (D).**
